revisedDescription: Let staff start a photo upload before they know which vehicle it belongs to, instead of always having to enter a VIN or registration first. The photos would go in as an unassigned upload, and staff can come back afterward to edit that upload and fill in the vehicle details — along with stage, part, and anything else — once they have them. The vehicle details still need to be filled in eventually; this just lets the photo come in first and the paperwork catch up after.

questions.prompt: Is this the right idea: let you upload a photo or file without picking a vehicle first, then go back afterward and fill in the vehicle details?
options: Close, but not quite -- see my comment
